name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Path of Mars) — 2 Intermediate — Wind Dance

system.description:
The clarity the warrior turns on their own strikes now serves their defense, letting them read and slip the blows they see coming.

Once activated, Wind Dance grants you two extra Dodge Ability Traits for the rest of the scene, which may exceed your generation's limits on Traits in a single Ability. You may activate it only once per scene and cannot stack multiple applications; any of these Dodge Traits you do not spend by the end of the scene disappear. Retest with Occult.
